criteria.text:
Given a git repo with a local bare origin, FAFF_WORKTREE_ROOT set to an empty temp dir, and a symlink at <root>/FAFF-9-x pointing to /tmp
When `faff worktree ensure --issue FAFF-9 --mode interactive --slug x --root <repo> --json` runs
Then it exits 0 with disposition "hand-over" and cause "setup-refused"
And detail.reason is "path is a symlink"
And `git worktree list` in the repo lists only the main checkout
criteria.exercised: Built repo with bare origin, FAFF_WORKTREE_ROOT=empty temp dir, symlink <root>/FAFF-9-x -> /tmp; ran faff worktree ensure --issue FAFF-9 --mode interactive --slug x --root <repo> --json
criteria.expected: exit 0, hand-over, setup-refused, reason 'path is a symlink', worktree list only main checkout
criteria.observed: exit 0; disposition hand-over; cause setup-refused; detail.reason 'path is a symlink'; git worktree list showed only the main checkout

criteria.text:
Given the same repo, no symlink, and a branch FAFF-9-x pushed to the origin but absent locally
When the same `faff worktree ensure … --json` runs
Then it exits 0 with disposition "hand-over" and cause "setup-refused"
And detail.reason is "remote branch exists" and detail.branch is "FAFF-9-x"
And the repo has no local branch FAFF-9-x
criteria.exercised: Fresh repo with bare origin; pushed FAFF-9-x to origin and deleted it locally; ran the same ensure command
criteria.expected: exit 0, hand-over, setup-refused, reason 'remote branch exists', branch FAFF-9-x, no local branch FAFF-9-x
criteria.observed: exit 0; hand-over; setup-refused; detail.reason 'remote branch exists'; detail.branch 'FAFF-9-x'; git branch listed only main

criteria.text:
Given a git repo with no origin, FAFF_WORKTREE_ROOT set to an empty temp dir, and the main checkout on branch main
When `faff worktree ensure --issue FAFF-9 --mode interactive --slug x --root <repo> --json` runs
Then it exits 0 with disposition "ready" and mode "fresh"
And base_ref is "main"
And base_sha equals `git -C <wt> rev-parse HEAD` and equals `git rev-parse main` in the repo
criteria.exercised: Repo with no remote on main, FAFF_WORKTREE_ROOT=empty temp dir; ran the ensure command; compared base_sha to git rev-parse in worktree and in repo
criteria.expected: exit 0, ready, fresh, base_ref main, base_sha == wt HEAD == main sha
criteria.observed: exit 0; disposition ready; mode fresh; base_ref main; base_sha equal to wt HEAD and to git rev-parse main

criteria.text:
Given PATH holds a faff stub whose worktree-root subcommand exits 1, and HOME is an empty temp dir
When `bash plugin/skills/faff-graft/setup-worktree.sh faff-9-x <repo>` runs
Then it exits 1
And stderr has a line starting "setup-worktree: faff worktree-root failed"
And HOME has no .faff directory
criteria.exercised: Stub faff first on PATH (worktree-root exits 1), HOME=empty temp dir; ran bash setup-worktree.sh faff-9-x <repo> from the bundled skill path
criteria.expected: exit 1, stderr line starting 'setup-worktree: faff worktree-root failed', no .faff in HOME
criteria.observed: exit 1; stderr 'setup-worktree: faff worktree-root failed (exit 1); refusing to fall back to $HOME'; HOME remained empty (no .faff)

criteria.text: A fresh create refuses when `origin/<branch>` exists, or when the check fails, with cause `setup-refused` and the reason in `detail`.
criteria.exercised: worktree ensure --issue FAFF-9 --mode interactive --slug x --json with (a) origin holding FAFF-9-x and local copy deleted, (b) origin set to nonexistent file:///tmp/holdout-1454b-nope.git
criteria.expected: cause setup-refused with detail.reason saying remote branch exists (a) / remote check failed (b), and no worktree or local branch created
criteria.observed: (a) cause setup-refused, detail.reason 'remote branch exists', wt null; (b) cause setup-refused, detail.reason 'remote branch check failed' (exit 128), wt null; in both no local FAFF-9-x branch, no extra worktree, root dir empty

delegated.text: A fresh create refuses a symlink or an existing entry at the worktree path, in `worktree ensure` before any script runs and in the bundled script, and never registers a worktree outside the root.
`setup-worktree.sh` exits 1 with a named error when the root lookup fails or no `faff` resolves, and never creates `$HOME/.faff`.
`recreate` has no `realCandidate` check, its comment names the checks that keep the worktree inside the root, and its "path already exists" refusal has a test.
A fresh result carries `base_sha` equal to the worktree's `HEAD`, and `base_ref` follows §3.5.
`docs/guide/cli.md` names `setup-refused` and `base_sha`; graft Step 3 names the branch on a `remote branch exists` refusal.
`npm run build` leaves the committed `worktree-ensure.js` and `build-manifest.json` matching the `.ts`.
